sqlMap.select: SELECT GR.BUYER, GR.GR_NO, GR.GR_SEQ, GR.STATUS, GR.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ITEM_NO, GR.DESCRIPTION, SUBSTRB(GR.SPECIFICATION,1,100) AS SPECIFICATION, GR.PO_NO, GR.PO_SEQ, GR.UNIT_MEASURE, LTRIM(TO_CHAR(GR.GR_QTY,'9999999999.000')) AS GR_QTY, LTRIM(TO_CHAR(GR.UNIT_PRICE,'9999999999.00000')) AS UNIT_PRICE,'KRW' AS CUR, LTRIM(TO_CHAR(GR.GR_AMT,'999999999.00')) AS GR_AMT, SUBSTR(GR.GR_DATE,1,4) AS DOC_YEAR, GR.GR_DATE, GR.GR_TIME, GR.ADD_USER_ID AS GR_EMP_NO, GR.ADD_USER_NAME AS GR_EMP_NM, GR.ADD_USER_DEPT_CODE AS GR_DEPT, GR.KEY_1 AS GR_DEPT_DESC, GR.KEY_2 AS ACCOUNT, GR.KEY_3 AS PLANT, GR.KEY_4 AS WORKAREA, GR.KEY_5 AS DIV_CODE, GR.KEY_6 AS ITEM_GB FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND GR WHERE GR.BUYER = 'KRHANH0009' AND GR.IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY GR.BUYER, GR.GR_NO, GR.GR_SEQ
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND GR SET IF_FLAG = #msgTy# , IF_DATM = SYSDATE , IF_MSG = #msgText# WHERE GR.BUYER = 'KRHANH0009' AND GR.GR_NO = #grNo# AND GR.GR_SEQ = #grSeq#
